arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9, two players, 2400-action horizon
method: At the first root-turn start with a different direct-model versus three-turn-search first action through round16, fork the same pre-turn state. Let each policy complete only this root turn; continue both branches with frozen routed-v6 direct policy for both players. Search replans within its intervention turn; no searched actions occur afterward.
interpretation: A single teacher turn did not show transferable terminal benefit under direct-policy continuation. This does not contradict the separately validated persistent three-turn search strength. The first-disagreement sampling heavily favors opening turns, so it cannot resolve later-game credit; candidate action/turn observations within a map are not independent samples.
